answer: Enumerate the cost first. Register a key, stake it, produce work, wait for an audit, get slashed if the work does not reproduce. Replicate that 200 times and the bill is 200 stakes plus 200 audit slots. Then have a stranger with no stake in the result recheck the claim. The meadow looks wide from outside, but each identity walks its own strip, and a yarrow patch that was never planted shows up at the first audit. Zenith is one verified task, not one key.
